about: Every quest-file field the quest builder (quest-editor.html, js/quest-editor.js) and the API's QuestCodec read or write, with its struct, byte offset, size, type, range and named values. Read docs/quest-fields.md first. Checked by dev/check-quest-fields.js. Edit this file by hand.

confidence.confirmed: offset, size and meaning agree in two or more independent sources (client trace, ReFrontier, 010 template, Erupe, a relation over all quest files)
confidence.one source: offset and size agree (codec round trip over every quest file and the client trace); the meaning has one source
confidence.guess: the meaning is not shown by any source

builderValues.edits: the builder has an input for it
builderValues.should edit: must change with a field the builder edits, but the builder does not set it
builderValues.not in the model: kept as raw bytes by the codec

sizes: size is the field's total bytes; an array has a count, and each element is size / count bytes. Offsets are hex, from the start of the struct named in struct.

body.at: header pointer 0 (0xc0 in every quest file; 0x16 in an event body)

spawnArea.at: header pointer 6 (+0x18) for large monsters, a small spawn slot for small ones

monsterNameAliases.note: Names in data/quests.json 'monsters' that differ from data/monster-ids.json.

Orugaron.why: Kamu and Nono Orugaron, the pair

Volganos.why: Japanese name of Lavasioth (ヴォルガノス)

Espinas Subspecies.why: エスピナス亜種 = Flaming/Burning Espinas

Kuarlusepusu.why: spelling of Kuarusepusu (クアルセプス)

Hypnocatrice Rare.why: ヒプノック希少種 = White/Silver Hypnocatrice

Dahren Mohran.why: catalog error: these quests (60576, 60577 ...) hunt Harudomerugu (司銀龍)

Gargwa.why: catalog error: Deer Chase Fest quests (シカ追い) hunt Anteka

unnamedAreaIds.note: Area ids used in data/quest-details.json (areaId = the map record's base camp) that data/area-ids.json does not name. Most are base camps listed in data/map-areas.json.
